:::{#exm-moments-low-order-die}
#### The variance of a die roll as a central moment

For the die roll $X$ of @exm-moment-die, $\E{X} = 7/2$ and $\E{X^2} = 91/6$.
By @thm-moments-low-order, the second [central moment](#def-central-moment) of $X$
is the [variance](#def-variance) $\Var{X}$,
which @thm-variance gives as:

$$
\ba
\Var{X}
&= \E{X^2} - \sqf{\E{X}}
&& \text{(simplified expression for variance)} \\
&= \frac{91}{6} - \paren{\frac{7}{2}}^2
&& \text{(substitute the raw moments)} \\
&= \frac{182}{12} - \frac{147}{12}
&& \text{(common denominator)} \\
&= \frac{35}{12}
&& \text{(subtract)}
\ea
$$

<!-- no-figure: the example computes single numbers, not data -->

:::
